modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villager-: Automates the lectern-break/place loop until a librarian offers your chosen enchanted book.
message.villager-reroll.started: Started. Press %s or type /reroll stop to stop.
message.villager-reroll.found_all: Found %s after %s attempt(s)! All targets found - list is now empty.
message.villager-reroll.found_more: Found %s after %s attempt(s)! %s target(s) left - move to a new villager and start again.
message.villager-reroll.look_floor: Look at the floor where the lectern should go, then try again.
reason.villager-reroll.world_changed: World changed or was unloaded. The lectern break was not confirmed.
reason.villager-reroll.no_lectern_item: No lectern in hotbar, offhand or inventory! (/reroll debug shows what the mod sees)
reason.villager-reroll.no_targets: No target enchantments set in config!
reason.villager-reroll.no_pos: No lectern position set! Use %s or /reroll pos.
reason.villager-reroll.villager_gone_sel: Selected villager is gone - select another one.
reason.villager-reroll.axe_low: Axe is almost broken - swap in a fresh one.
reason.villager-reroll.break_failed: Could not break the lectern — it is out of reach or breaks too slowly.
reason.villager-reroll.break_unconfirmed: The server did not confirm the lectern was broken. The cycle stopped and will not place another lectern or read trades.
reason.villager-reroll.break_occupied: The lectern spot has a different block. The break was not accepted, so the cycle stopped.
reason.villager-reroll.break_cancelled: Lectern break was cancelled because the world changed or was unloaded.
reason.villager-reroll.chunk_unloaded: The lectern chunk is not loaded, so the break cannot be confirmed. The cycle stopped.
reason.villager-reroll.pickup_out_of_ran: Lectern dropped out of pickup range - stand closer to the lectern spot.
reason.villager-reroll.item_lost: Lectern item disappeared before it could be picked up.
reason.villager-reroll.walk_failed: Could not reach the dropped lectern - is something in the way?
reason.villager-reroll.walk_back_failed: Could not walk back to the starting spot - is something in the way?
reason.villager-reroll.trade_screen: Could not open the trade screen. Stand next to the villager so the crosshair can reach them.
reason.villager-reroll.too_far: The villager is out of reach, so the trade screen was not opened.
reason.villager-reroll.place_failed: The lectern did not stay placed. Stand where you can reach that block, and don't stand inside it.
reason.villager-reroll.no_profession: The villager never became a librarian. Clear a path from them to the lectern.
reason.villager-reroll.stuck_crawl: Stopped because sneaking trapped you in a gap too low to stand.
status.villager-reroll.place_wait: Waiting for the lectern to stay placed...
status.villager-reroll.await_server: Waiting for the server to confirm the lectern is gone...
status.villager-reroll.chunk_wait: Lectern chunk is not loaded, waiting...
hud.villager-reroll.title: VILLAGER REROLLER
screen.villager-reroll.title: Villager Trade Reroller
screen.villager-reroll.subtitle: The reroller stops on the first enchantment it finds, then removes that one from the list.
screen.villager-reroll.empty: No targets yet - click "+ Add Enchantment" below.
config.villager-reroll.lectern.tooltip:
Set the block position where the mod will place and break the lectern.

Stand where you can see that spot, then click 'Use My Position'.
Or type the coordinates manually below.
config.villager-reroll.use_position.desc:
Sets the lectern position to the block you are currently looking at.

Aim your crosshair at the block where you want the lectern placed, then click this button.

Or press %s in-game while looking at the block.
config.villager-reroll.clear.desc:
Clears the saved lectern position.
The reroller will not start until a new position is set.
config.villager-reroll.x.desc:
X coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
config.villager-reroll.y.desc:
Y coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
config.villager-reroll.z.desc:
Z coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
config.villager-reroll.timing.tooltip:
Adjust delays to make the reroller act human-like.
Increase these if your server desyncs or kicks you.
config.villager-reroll.close_delay.desc:
How long to wait after closing the trade screen
before breaking the lectern.

20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 20.
Increase this if the server seems to desync.
config.villager-reroll.retry_delay.desc:
How long to wait after the server confirms the lectern is gone
before placing a new one.

This delay is not treated as proof that the block broke.
20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 40.
Increase this on laggier servers.
config.villager-reroll.pickup.desc:
If the broken lectern lands out of pickup range, walk over
(sneaking, so you can't fall off edges), pick it up, then
walk back to where you were standing.

Default: on. Command: /reroll pickup true|false
config.villager-reroll.radius.desc:
How far to look for the nearest villager when none is selected.

Default: 6 blocks. Command: /reroll radius <1-16>
config.villager-reroll.hud.desc:
Show the status overlay while the reroller is running.

Displays: status, target, attempt count, last trade seen.
Default: on. Command: /reroll hud on|off
config.villager-reroll.hud_scale.desc:
Size of the HUD overlay.

Default: 1.0. Command: /reroll hud scale <0.5-2.0>
config.villager-reroll.hud_pos.desc:
Which edge/corner of the screen the HUD sits in.

Default: middle left. Command: /reroll hud pos <corner>
config.villager-reroll.hud_compact.desc:
Show only a single status line instead of the full panel.

Default: off. Command: /reroll hud compact true|false
config.villager-reroll.highlight.desc:
Draw a glowing outline around the villager you selected.
Only visible to you.

Default: on. Command: /reroll highlight true|false
command.villager-reroll.help:
Client-side commands (never sent to the server):
/reroll start | stop
/reroll pos [x y z | clear]  - lectern spot (no args = where you look)
/reroll villager [clear]  - select the villager you look at
/reroll add <enchant> [minLevel] [maxCost]
/reroll remove <enchant> | list | clear
/reroll hud on|off | scale <0.5-2> | pos <corner> | compact <true|false>
/reroll delay close|retry <ticks> | radius <blocks> | highlight <true|false>
/reroll pickup <true|false>  - walk to a dropped lectern and back
/reroll settings | config [more] | debug
command.villager-reroll.villager_cleared: Villager selection cleared - nearest villager will be used.
command.villager-reroll.pickup: Walk to pick up dropped lectern: %s
command.villager-reroll.not_in_list: %s is not in the target list.
command.villager-reroll.list_empty: Target list is empty. Add one with /reroll add <enchant>.
